text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 80 voriconazole 50 mg tablets (6.3 days), Corvale General holds 342.4 tablets (21.3 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 78 tablets (26.3 days). All sites use Aurobindo Pharma Limited product (NDC 65862089103) manufactured at FEI 3007373532 in India.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1105823 of that plant ended 2019-09-27 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI); the classification was known to FDA on 2019-12-26. A later inspection 1169446 ended 2022-05-10 and was classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). Voriconazole is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of today.

Our position: Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside each have more than two weeks on hand and can support a transfer. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list, but their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 36 tablets from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Transfer 99 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
3. Purchase from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. — requires buyer execution.
4. Purchase from American Health Packaging — requires buyer execution.
5. Purchase from AvPAK — requires buyer execution.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions; those are for the treating clinicians and the committee.
